name: Japan
summary: Archipelagic nation in East Asia with heavily forested mountainous terrain. Combines dense coastal urban centers with extensive solar installations and strict urban clean air standards while importing liquefied natural gas and coal.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 2.24x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); meets Japanese national ambient standard of 15 µg/m³.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; JMA reported highest nationwide average temperature since records began in 1898.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate over 1994-2023 across Japanese meteorological stations.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 2.7% share of global fossil emissions; 5th largest national emitter globally.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Industrialized per capita footprint driven by thermal power dependence following 2011 nuclear idling.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Among the most densely forested OECD nations; mountainous topography preserves ancient cedar and beech cover.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Solar generation expanded to 9.9% of grid supply alongside conventional hydro (7.6%) and growing offshore wind.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 338 people/km²; urban population fraction is 92.0%.
